item.title: GeoPura wins £32.6m deal to supply hydrogen for Lower Thames Crossing
item.description: National Highways has named GeoPura, a Nottingham-based hydrogen innovator, as its supplier of green hydrogen for the Lower Thames Crossing project, delivering what is expected to be the largest volume of the fuel ever produced for a British construction project.

item.title: Highways Live: Sustainable and resilient highways workshops
item.description: Highways has launched a new series of events in partnership with the Road Surface Treatments Association (RSTA) to encourage authorities and suppliers to collaborate on building a new future for maintenance strategies.

item.title: Powys appoints 10 companies to 'dynamic purchasing system'
item.description: Powys County Council has appointed 10 suppliers to its dynamic purchasing system for the provision of highways and civil engineering works across the county.

item.title: Morgan Sindall sees record growth as profits pass £5bn
item.description: Morgan Sindall Group saw a record year of growth in 2025, surpassing £5bn in revenue for the first time, as profits grew by 35%.

item.title: Local EV charging guide released by CIHT
item.description: The Chartered Institution of Highways & Transportation (CIHT) has published Rolling out Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure: Advice for Local Authorities, a new report intended to help councils deliver public EV charging networks that are ‘reliable, accessible and fit for a net zero future’.

item.title: Traffex 2026: By the sector for the sector
item.description: Traffex returns to Coventry this May with a conference programme developed by the sector for the sector: helping give our industry the tools it needs to finish the job.

item.title: Highways Presents: Galvmac and the future of road repairs
item.description: Highways enjoys a day out with the team at Galvmac to find out about its use of elastomac - a highly durable, sustainable, eco-friendly road repair material made with 69% recycled aggregate, recycled bitumen and recycled polymers. They say it's the future of road repairs…and they make a good case.

item.title: Heidelberg and GW Highways hit 60% recycled material in Kent
item.description: Heidelberg Materials partnered with GW Highways to design a durable asphalt made with 60% recycled material for use on a section of the A20 in the centre of Maidstone.

item.title: TfWM and Citymapper form new partnership
item.description: Transport for West Midlands (TfWM) has formed a new partnership with travel app Citymapper, providing a journey planner on its website powered by Citymapper’s award-winning technology.

item.title: Oxford Street pedestrianisation expected by September
item.description: The pedestrianisation of Oxford Street has been given final approval by the Mayor of London, with plans to remove vehicle access to part of the street by September of this year.
